restore_policy: User authorized isolated ordinary Restore preparation and measured ordinary restores as needed with --allow-restore; no ordinary builds, private credentials or authenticated feeds. Evaluation-only SDK prepass covers all four corpora. Only with explicit restore grant, warm_fixture_packages then prepares fixture packages and records provenance in sdk-bootstrap.json; a separate corpus Restore preparation pass follows before one combined package/config freeze. Qualification snapshots a pristine prepared checkout once and copy2-replays exact bytes/mtimes at the same path. Every runtime.index receives the explicit grant; no database receipts are seeded. Frozen external inputs and source/asset provenance remain checked, and native restore outcomes—not successful evaluation alone—govern reviewed standing.
capture_format: Each <id>.<platform>.<host_kind>.capture.json.gz is deterministic gzip (mtime=0) over JSON; platform is linux/darwin/win32 and host_kind is sdk/framework. capture_digest hashes parsed JSON independent of compression. Successful queries retain full normalized metadata without duplicate stdout; failures retain native output/codes. Physical source inventory/count/digest remains independent of product output.
metadata_scope: Direct capture queries evaluated properties and six item groups: Compile, ProjectReference, Reference, PackageReference, PackageDownload, PackageVersion. These queried values support metadata/restore authority; they do not claim complete import, glob-dependency or worker-protocol equivalence.
restore_graph_scope: Observe _RestoreGraphEntryFiltered after ordinary Restore in the same invocation. Never use -getTargetResult or add helper targets, and never override repository static-graph policy. Preserve raw stdout/stderr. Stable graph projection sorts records, removes only synthetic GUID item identity-derived built-ins and normalizes paths/mtimes, retaining actual Type, project/framework bindings, DownloadDependency and all other dependency metadata. Missing, empty or non-JSON graph output remains explicit, not assumed success or fabricated coverage.
restore_currentness_scope: Authorized captures must retain final native assets project/restore/framework/dependency/log data, library identity/hash/path plus file-list digest, and target dependency shape, excluding large compile/runtime/file tables. Full dgspec/cache JSON (including native cache success and dgSpecHash) and bounded generated XML are reviewable. Exact raw/full-canonical hashes remain. Final package evidence records expectedPackageFiles, archive SHA512/SHA256, small native marker/metadata text, and extracted expected-file content inventory, plus project/framework-bound DownloadDependency locations; unavailable observations remain explicit and are not standing verdicts.
restore_overwrite_binding: Each ordinary Restore records its invoked/native-graph output scopes and post-invocation raw/canonical input hashes. Final prepared inputs identify the last matching Restore observation (or explicit null); each earlier observation reports added, removed or overwritten inputs versus final state. Review final projections with the matching native graph, not a stale earlier exit-zero/graph. Authority rejects old captures without currentness schema, native projections, package observations or final-state binding. No timestamps or Tethys output establish currentness.
host_authority: SDK mode invokes dotnet plus selected SDK MSBuild.dll. Framework mode requires actual Windows and --host-kind framework --host <VS MSBuild directory containing MSBuild.exe>, invoking that executable directly for metadata and authorized Restore. Captures record host kind/platform/path/binary digest plus SDK digest; evaluated MSBuildBinPath/runtime and product host provenance must agree. run_corpus accepts host/host_kind and passes the exact host to Runtime.index. Choose host/platform-specific authority through --manifest and {platform}/{host_kind} expectation names; Linux authority never substitutes for Windows proof.
public_acquisition: Only fixed approved github.com HTTPS URLs; minimal fresh Git environment with empty disposable HOME, no ambient token/proxy/config variables, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 and null global/system configs. Credential helpers, hooks, askpass/terminal prompts, redirects, SSH/file/non-HTTPS protocols and submodule recursion are disabled. Windows receives only necessary explicit OS paths. Git scratch remains on the caller-selected filesystem.
repetition_lifecycle: Acquire pinned checkout, ordinary-restore and independent direct-capture once per repository; validate reviewed authority then snapshot the pristine prepared checkout with copy2. Serial batch/stream repetitions copy2-recreate that prepared tree at the same canonical workspace path, preserving raw restore bytes/mtimes, with new DB/process each run and unique external evidence labels. Per-run frozen environment/source/asset checks remain. Only owned successful workspaces/snapshots are deleted; failures retain both and preexisting paths reject. This is a fresh prepared-checkout copy, not repeated network acquisition or restore.
environment_policy: For subsequent capture use --environment with the same frozen environment and omit --bootstrap-sdk-cache. Pass controlled_environment(environment_root, sdk) exactly as Runtime.environment; build tooling uses a separate original build environment. Provenance hashes package/user-config contents and preflighted external config bytes; HTTP cache responses, temporary files and mtimes are excluded. CoreCLR/desktop plugin override lists contain only the platform separator, selecting no plugins without falling back to defaults. Windows inspects actual known-folder user and machine configs/plugins; safe public nuget.org and existing local offline sources are allowed, credentials/uncontrolled sections or plugins reject. macOS /Library/Application Support/NuGet and Unix ancestors receive the same config preflight. Every capture/qualification checks frozen state before/after; changed authority requires explicit bootstrap and review.

review_contract.expected_projects: Exact project roster {project, standing, reason/evidence when indeterminate, rationale, restore_input_status (current/not-required/missing/invalid/unavailable), restore_evidence}. Review native Restore outcomes and asset currentness independently under the declared measured restore grant. Pre-index missing assets alone do not force restore-required when measured Restore is authorized. Failed outer evaluations remain project-level; never fabricate unit slots or infer confirmation from direct evaluation alone.
review_contract.expected_units: Exact list of independently enumerated slots {project, target_framework (string or null), standing, reason/evidence when indeterminate, rationale}. Failed OUTER evaluation remains an indeterminate PROJECT, never a unit. Failed INNER evaluation retains its known selector. Direct evaluation-attempt baseline is not published-unit count; do not fabricate387 units from387 direct attempts. Source/project/attempt/published-unit counts remain separate.
review_contract.workflow: Capture writes <id>.<platform>.<host_kind>.capture.json.gz and matching unreviewed expected JSON with null expected_projects/expected_units/expected_exit. Review raw restore outcomes, prepared asset currentness, outer/inner metadata and native failure evidence on that actual platform/host. Commit captures and expectations adjacent to the selected manifest. Successful evaluation alone never establishes standing; cross-platform/host or fingerprint substitution rejects.

sdk_context.note: Declared SDK policy, not an assertion of installed host compatibility. Capture records actual selected MSBuild binary. Newtonsoft has no root global.json; MSBuild has no sdk.version.

repositories.source_policy: Fresh detached checkout; every tracked edit rejected. Explicit Restore may add only captured exact NuGet assets under evaluated project extension directories/default obj: project.assets.json, project.nuget.cache, *.nuget.g.props, *.nuget.g.targets, *.nuget.dgspec.json. Raw file digests are checked before/after indexing; cross-root comparison uses full normalized content (derived dgSpecHash excluded, complete dgspec retained). Only additional .rivets/index/tethys.db and -wal/-shm are allowed after indexing. Unrelated obj/tracker/source changes reject. Gitlinks remain pinned/uninitialized.

expected_standing.authority: Independent direct-MSBuild capture plus explicit human-reviewed per-project/framework standing/reason/evidence; never product output or assumed Confirmed. Commit both capture and reviewed expectation before qualification.
